painpoints.text: Stale nextest test-listing recurred this run (fabro-155b, run 01M2ZSYQR4ZM8N6HD67TT3AT3X): after editing test code in lib/foundation/fabro-client/src/client.rs, `cargo nextest list/run -p fabro-client` kept showing the OLD test set until `touch` forced a rebuild — a fresh `cargo nextest list` answered with zero matches and looked like the tests vanished.
